desc.name: WebView_Dangerous_Config
desc.detail: APIMode (call-site report, no taint). Flags WebView configurations that turn a loaded page into an app-compromise primitive: addJavascriptInterface (JS->Java bridge, RCE on pre-API17 or any @JavascriptInterface method), setAllowUniversalAccessFromFileURLs / setAllowFileAccessFromFileURLs (file:// pages read arbitrary local files and same-origin any origin), and setAllowContentAccess. Cross-reference with WebView_Tainted_Load: a tainted load INTO one of these WebViews is the exploitable chain.
